summary: MIP-18 revises Marinade's fee structure: removes the fixed 9.5% performance fee, replaces it with a conditional fee charged only when Marinade APY exceeds the Solana Staking Rate (inflation + tx + priority fees, MEV excluded), and unifies a 20 bps unstake fee across Native, mSOL, and Select. No treasury disbursement.

questions_to_ask: What is the numeric rate of the conditional performance fee when Marinade APY exceeds SSR — is it the prior 9.5%, a new value, or determined by a separate parameter?

Who computes the Solana Staking Rate, on what cadence, and through what mechanism (on-chain program, oracle, off-chain attestation), and is there a dispute or correction process if the computed SSR is contested?

What is the projected change in DAO revenue under representative scenarios (e.g., low-reward epochs where Marinade matches SSR vs. high-reward epochs with material outperformance), and what TVL or staker-acquisition uplift is required to offset any expected revenue reduction?
When does the new fee structure take effect, and is there a review checkpoint (e.g., 6 or 12 months post-implementation) at which the DAO will reassess realized capture vs. expectations?
How is the 20 bps unstake fee expected to interact with delayed-unstake vs. immediate-unstake flows, and does it apply to validator-initiated unstakes or only user-initiated exits?
